transcript.text: Now I'll compute net revenue for region='West', status='completed', orders in calendar year 2025, joining orders to customers.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) as net_cents, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
